label: close(t+21)/close(t+1)-1; remove labels crossing each segment end

data_definition_rejects.name: CASH_SURPLUS_OVER_ASSETS
data_definition_rejects.reason: No full-scope assets and raw operating cashflow amounts; not estimated.

data_definition_rejects.name: REVENUE_SCALED_EARNINGS_SURPRISE
data_definition_rejects.reason: MBRevenue is frequently missing and inconsistent with npMargin denominator. No analyst expectation or reliable shared revenue denominator; not relabelled as SUE.

representative_selection: For each family, select the first fixed-order candidate with coverage>=0.70 in both screen years and positive RankIC in both. No ranking by performance. Allows predeclared weak-positive combination exploration despite failed significance; does not upgrade single-factor status.
model_comparisons: All nonempty subsets of at most three selected family representatives, each versus BASE on one matched universe; all comparisons counted in a fixed seven-test BH family. Bundle-minus-one contrasts are diagnostic only.
costs: Frozen M0 rates, limit and close execution approximations; identical five-trading-day rebalance schedule for every variant; 238-day arithmetic annualization.
primary_universe: Daily historical nonfinancial CSI300 with contemporaneously known industry, active observations and available size; candidate missingness disclosed, common model sample depends on features only, not future labels.
financial_policy: BaoStock-only observed raw histories, missing requests stay missing, no mixed-provider arithmetic. Same code and fiscal quarter, maximum dependency publication strictly before signal. Latest partial release clears older values. 400/550-day staleness. Revision unknown retained.
failure: No new candidates, sign/window changes or budget reset after outcomes. No eligible representatives => NO_ENTRY; insufficient model sample => DATA_GATE_FAIL; model gate failure => NO_GO.
protected_periods: 2021-2025 SEALED; no automatic qualification, lockbox or trading
research_status: Adaptive and already-observed historical research only; 20-day protocol is new and both BASE/ADD retrain identically, no amendment of M0/M2/M3 results.
